# Overview

Which results are robust and which depend on the sample? M0 and M1-mm for each question separately (as in
`5_entrytags.Rmd`), in a time window and in the same window restricted to states and empires (groups only, conditional
answers, plus the two parent questions):

| sample | entries |
|---|---|
| window | `year_from` in the window (default 1500 BCE to 1500 CE) |
| window, states and empires | window, and society type state or empire (`social_complexity_large`); entries without a codable society type left out |

Social complexity enters as a subset, not as a covariate: in the window (1500 BCE to 1500 CE), 231 of 340 group entries
are states or empires and 73 are bands, tribes or chiefdoms (36 not codable), so a covariate would rest on few entries.
The variable is also ambiguous (society vs. religious group; see the Social Complexity tab).

| model | formula |
|---|---|
| M0 | `time + (1 | world_region)` |
| M1-mm | `time + (1 | mm(traditions)) + (1 | world_region)` |

Time = `year_from` / 1000 (0 = 0 CE, the middle of the default window). Slopes (log-odds per 1,000 years) are
comparable to the full-sample fits in `5_entrytags.Rmd` (centred at 1000 CE; centring only changes the intercept).
Same priors as before.

The figure and table compare with the full sample (M0 and M1-mm from `5_entrytags.Rmd`, read, not refit).

Run from inside `modeling/` after `3_prepare_data.py` and `5_entrytags.Rmd`. To change the window, edit `window` in `setup` (fits are saved
with the window in the file name). Fits in `fits/`, figures in `fig/window/<window>/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)

options(mc.cores = 4, brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))

window <- c(-1500, 1500)
window_tag <- str_replace_all(paste(window, collapse = "_"), "-", "m")

# figures: shown in the session and saved as fig/window/<window>/<name>.jpg
fig_dir <- file.path("fig/window", window_tag)
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_plot <- function(p, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".jpg")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  p
}

sample_labels <- c(window = "window", window_large = "window, states and empires")
model_labels <- c(m0 = "M0", m1_mm = "M1-mm")
# shown in figure and table (M0, states and empires is fitted but not shown)
variant_labels <- c(
  m0_full = "M0, full", m0_window = "M0, window",
  m1_mm_full = "M1-mm, full", m1_mm_window = "M1-mm, window", m1_mm_window_large = "M1-mm, window, states and empires"
)
variant_colors <- c(
  m0_full = "#b4b2ad", m0_window = "#5f5e5a",
  m1_mm_full = "#8fbbe8", m1_mm_window = "#2a78d6", m1_mm_window_large = "#1baf7a"
)
```

# Data

```{r data, message = FALSE}
covariates <- read_csv("../data/preprocessed/entry_covariates.csv") |>
  select(entry_id, social_complexity, social_complexity_large)

d <- read_csv("data/model_data.csv") |>
  filter(poll == "group") |>
  left_join(covariates, by = "entry_id") |>
  mutate(time = year_from / 1000)

parent_questions <- c("supernatural monitoring present", "supreme high god present")
topic_order <- c(
  "murder coreligionists", "murder other religions", "murder other polities", "non-lethal fighting",
  "prosocial norm adherence", "lying", "honouring oaths", "property crimes", "economic fairness",
  "gossiping", "laziness", "shirking risk", "disrespecting elders", "sex",
  "ritual observance", "performance of rituals", "taboos", "personal hygiene", "sorcery",
  "conversion non-religionists",
  "knowledge this world", "causal efficacy the world", "indirect causal efficacy the world", "communicates with living",
  "is unquestionably good", "positive emotion", "negative emotion",
  "is anthropomorphic", "possesses hunger", "is sky deity", "is chthonic",
  "permissible to worship other god?",
  "is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty"
)
all_questions <- c(parent_questions, topic_order)

questions <- d |>
  distinct(family, question_short) |>
  filter(question_short %in% all_questions) |>
  mutate(family = factor(family, levels = c("parent", "monitoring", "shg")))

# parent questions and child questions (conditional), as in 5_entrytags.Rmd
d_cond <- d |> filter(question_short %in% parent_questions | (family != "parent" & !inferred))

samples <- list(
  window = filter(d_cond, between(year_from, window[1], window[2])),
  window_large = filter(d_cond, between(year_from, window[1], window[2]), social_complexity_large == 1)
)
```

Entries per sample (full sample for comparison), by world region, tradition (priority label) and society type:

```{r data_overview}
all_samples <- bind_rows(c(list(full = d_cond), samples), .id = "sample") |>
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = c("full", names(samples))))

count_by <- function(var) {
  all_samples |>
    distinct(sample, entry_id, {{ var }}) |>
    count(sample, {{ var }}) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
}
count_by(world_region)
count_by(tradition)
count_by(social_complexity)
```

Entries per question (median and minimum over the child questions):

```{r data_questions}
all_samples |>
  filter(!question_short %in% parent_questions) |>
  group_by(sample, question_short) |>
  summarise(entries = n_distinct(entry_id), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  summarise(median = median(entries), min = min(entries))
```

# Models

```{r models}
mm_term <- "(1 | mm(trad1, trad2, trad3, weights = cbind(w1, w2, w3), scale = FALSE))"
base <- "answer_value | weights(weight) ~ 0 + Intercept + time + (1 | world_region)"
formulas <- list(
  m0 = bf(as.formula(base)),
  m1_mm = bf(as.formula(paste(base, "+", mm_term)))
)

priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
)
```

# Fit

Each model is compiled once (`chains = 0`) and then refit for each sample and question with `update()`.

```{r fit, message = FALSE, results = "hide"}
templates <- map(formulas, function(formula) {
  suppressWarnings(brm(formula, data = samples$window, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors,
                       chains = 0, refresh = 0, silent = 2))
})

fit_question <- function(sample, model, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/window_%s_%s_%s_%s.rds", window_tag, sample, model, question)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  fit <- update(
    templates[[model]],
    newdata = filter(samples[[sample]], question_short == question),
    chains = 4, iter = 2000, seed = 2026, refresh = 0,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
  )
  saveRDS(fit, path)
  fit
}

fits <- crossing(sample = names(samples), model = names(formulas), question = all_questions) |>
  mutate(fit = pmap(list(sample, model, question), fit_question))

# full sample: existing fits from 5_entrytags.Rmd (not refit here)
full_fits <- crossing(sample = "full", model = names(formulas), question = all_questions) |>
  mutate(fit = map2(model, question, ~ readRDS(sprintf("fits/entrytags_%s_%s.rds", .x, .y))))
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
diagnostics <- fits |>
  mutate(diag = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_|^sd_", regex = TRUE))
    tibble(
      max_rhat = max(s$rhat),
      min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk),
      min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail),
      divergences = sum(subset(nuts_params(fit), Parameter == "divergent__")$Value)
    )
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(diag)

# fits with any problem
diagnostics |> filter(max_rhat > 1.01 | min_ess_bulk < 400 | min_ess_tail < 400 | divergences > 0)
```

# Time slopes

```{r estimates}
slopes <- bind_rows(full_fits, fits) |>
  filter(paste(model, sample, sep = "_") %in% names(variant_labels)) |>
  mutate(est = map(fit, function(fit) {
    x <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = "b_time")$b_time
    tibble(mean = mean(x), lower = quantile(x, 0.025), upper = quantile(x, 0.975))
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
  mutate(
    question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions)),
    variant = factor(paste(model, sample, sep = "_"), levels = names(variant_labels))
  )
```

Change in log-odds per 1,000 years (95% interval):

```{r slopes, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 12}
p_slopes <- ggplot(slopes, aes(mean, question, colour = variant)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = variant_colors, labels = variant_labels) +
  labs(x = "Time slope (log-odds per 1,000 years)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
save_plot(p_slopes, "slopes", 9, 12)
```

Slopes and credibility (+ / -: 95% interval excludes 0):

```{r credible}
slopes |>
  arrange(variant) |>
  mutate(
    cell = sprintf("%.2f%s", mean, case_when(lower > 0 ~ " +", upper < 0 ~ " -", TRUE ~ "")),
    column = variant_labels[as.character(variant)]
  ) |>
  select(family, question, column, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = column, values_from = cell) |>
  arrange(family, desc(question)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
